_comment: Regression fixture for the reader's segmenter. Run with `npm run check-segmentation`. Every excerpt is real text from public/books/xiyouji and every expected tokenisation has been reviewed by hand. `fix` cases are ones the old greedy leftmost-longest scan got wrong and the current algorithm gets right — `wasGreedy` records the old output so a regression is obvious. `keep` cases are ones greedy already got right, including the classical vocabulary that a modern frequency prior would destroy; those exist so that tuning the scoring cannot quietly trade them away.

fix.text: 只见辕门外有人来报道：「那大圣引一群
fix.note: 报道 before a quote is 报 + 道 'reported, saying', not 'a news report'

fix.text: 一个石猴，应声高叫道：「我进去，我进
fix.note: quotative 道 is the speech verb and must not be absorbed by the preceding word

fix.text: 掩。悟空喜道：「老师父果然注意与我传道
fix.note: 老师父 is 老 + 师父 'venerable master', not 老师 'teacher' + 父

fix.text: 化不得我。我老孙五百年前大闹天宫，被太
fix.note: 百年 must not straddle the numeral run; the text says five hundred years ago, not 'a century'

fix.text: 斗云，霎时间过了二百里水面。果见那厢有
fix.note: 百里 is a surname in CC-CEDICT and must not be formed across a numeral boundary

fix.text: 门来，高叫道：「甚么人在此搔扰？」猴
fix.note: 甚么 comes from the book name list; CC-CEDICT has no entry for the Ming spelling

fix.text: 来，不伤身体者，我等即拜他为王。」连
fix.note: 伤身体 is 伤 + 身体; greedy split the real word 身体 in half

fix.text: 那祖师即命大众引孙悟空出二门外，教他洒
fix.note: 命大众 is 命 'to order' + 大众 'the assembly', not 命大 'lucky' + 众

keep.text: ，道：「陛下，诏老孙有何升赏？」玉帝
keep.note: 老孙, Sun Wukong's self-reference, comes from the book name list

keep.text: 却说那花果山大小猴儿
keep.note: 却说, the storyteller's transition, from the book name list

keep.text: 忙哈哈跪下道：「弼马温果是神通广大，末
keep.note: book name list entry, and 神通广大 must stay whole as a chengyu

keep.text: 师父，你是唐姓，怎的和他是华宗？」三
keep.note: 怎的 is classical vocabulary a modern frequency prior would fragment

keep.text: 幽冥界城门之外，却才醒悟。是我显神通
居此界终始如何，且听下回分解。
keep.note: the six-character chapter-closing formula must stay whole

keep.text: 上界回奏。玉帝与观音菩萨、王母并众仙卿，
keep.note: four-character deity names must stay whole

keep.text: 」童子道：「我家师父正才下榻，登坛讲
keep.note: 师父 (1,633 occurrences) is the single most important word in the book
